notes.title: What is IOD?
notes.content:
Isle of Dinosaurs 2D or IOD is a classic action maze game with retro pixel art graphics featuring two playable characters, co-op gameplay and dinosaurs developed by a single indie developer.

Hi! My name is Gali and I am the game designer for Isle of Dinosaurs 2d. I will be your host for the entire development period of the game and also will be available for post-release support and modding.

Before going into details about IOD, you might want to check the game's development history so far:


 50+ game development blog posts
 Gameplay megathread
 70+ game development videos


On gameplay

Gameplay is work in progress.
So far I played with gameplay concepts like: bomberman, maze, dungeon, mini-dota, tower defense, obbie and many other variations.
At the moment there are two playable characters: Kil and Mil
There will be at least 10 dinosaurs bosses to beat and 10 minions corresponding to each dinosaur type.
So far I have tested single player and split screen, one player with Kil and other with Mil.

The following characters will be included in the first demo release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36054349/0bd166ca56d4cd33e639c9df15db2e67ca66d2bd.png

On maps

There is a big map that requires exploration and it contains entry points to smaller maps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36054349/a997d130220efbb7f58980894fa3d20d6b70bdb8.png

On development and funding


 my first game
 self-funded and self-published
 originated as passion project
 game engine and game logic written from scratch
 JavaScript (TypeScript), Canvas2D
 classic frame-by-frame animations
 art-style is retro pixel art with warm colors
 art direction requires in-game entities to be family friendly
 controller and keyboard support
 co-op


How can you help?


 play the demo
 provide feedback on gameplay and new characters
 add the game to Wishlist or Follow it



End goals


 ship a funny little game for all ages
 keep the gameplay and game input simple
 modding and map support
 open-source the engine library



If you like IOD please consider adding the game to your Wishlist or simply Follow it by pressing the buttons on the Isle of Dinosaurs Store Page!
